value.rationale: The 2015 primary source identifies a concrete failure of classical Alltop generators for unrestricted phase retrieval. Changing one amplitude is a minimal, easily specified repair with practical tomography relevance. The theorem finds an exact all-parameter success/failure region and an unexpected prime-congruence dichotomy: universal positive-real repair for p=3 mod 4 versus isolated explicit high-amplitude defects at p=1 mod 4 (starting demonstrably at p=17). This is not only the generic claim that sufficiently small perturbations work.
